description: Newest results first, with subject, column, description, grade, weight, test type, period, date, remarks and resit info. limit defaults to 50 (max 1000, paged). dossier=examen gives school-exam (SE) results. Also the next publication moment when the school uses one. Use this for "what grades came in recently"; use grades for a short summary with averages, subject_grades for all columns of one subject.
